title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Loan Transaction Window for Deductible Decreases
content:
## Loan transaction window — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

**Applies to:** a pending deductible decrease recorded for a loan transaction on a NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) tier that carries no ICC coverage.

**Measure.** The transaction window is measured from the request date to the loan closing date recorded on the request.

**Length.**

| Loan number recorded on the request | Reading | Window |
|---|---|---|
| A loan number other than the one on the policy | The loan is being made or refinanced | 60 days |
| The loan number on the policy | That loan is being increased, extended or renewed | 30 days |
| No loan number | — | No days |

**Consequence.** When the loan closing does not fall within the window, the change may take effect no earlier than 30 days after the receipt date (the later of the request date and the date of the latest premium payment received on or after it).

*Hypothetical cases.* A request naming a new lender's loan number with a closing 60 days after the request date is within the window; with a closing 61 days after it, it is not. A request naming the loan already on the policy with a closing 31 days after the request date is outside its 30-day window.
